verdict.rationale: Datalab converts documents into structured formats (Markdown, HTML, JSON, chunks), which suggests some structure is carried through. Its segment endpoint splits documents into logical sections with page ranges. However, no evidence explicitly says headings, section hierarchy, or reading order are preserved in parsed output, so structure preservation is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading and section hierarchy in JSON or Markdown output, reading-order handling for multi-column or complex layouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of structural fidelity.
